SPECIFICATION FOR 
TAPERED ADAPTER SLEEVES FOR ROLLING BEARINGS 



1. Scope — Covers the requirements of tapered adapter sleeves for use with rolling bearings in the 
diameter range of 15 to 2G0 mm and suitable for bearing dimensions series 02, 12, 13, 22, 23, 31 
and 32. 

2. Dimensions — As given in Table 1. 

2.1 The tapered adapter sleeves shall have fine screw threads conforming to 15:4218-1967 * ISO 
metric screw threads \ 

3. Material — Conforming to grade St 42-1079 of IS : 1079-1973 'Specification for hot-rolled carbon 
steel sheet and strip {third revision) \ 

3.1 Other suitable materials are C20 and C30 of IS: 2073-1970 'Specification for carbon steel black 
bars for production of machined parts for general engineering purposes (first revision) 1 and 
class 2 and class 3 of IS: 1875-1970 'Specification for carbon steel billets, blooms, slabs and 
bars for forgings ( third revision ) '. 

4. General Requirements 

4.1 Workmanship — The adapter sleeves shall be cleanly finished, sound and free from burrs and 
defects which may affect their serviceability. 

4.2 Preservation — The adapter sleeves shall be supplied in a well cleaned condition and suitably 
protected against corrosion. 

5. Designation — A tapered adapter sleeve shall be designated by sleeve bore diameter, nominal 
diameter of bearing bore at the small bore end (the iwo separated by a hyphen), the symbol 
* HMB ', the sleeve length (see 2398-1967 Identification code for rolling bearings) and the number 
of this standard. 



Example: 

A tapered adapter sleeve with sleeve bore diameter 100 mm, nominal diameter of bearing 
bore 110 mm and sleeve length 81 mm shall be designated as: 

Adapter Sleeve 100 - 110 HMB 81 IS : 8656 
6. ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution.

IS: 8656 -1977 

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

Tapered adapter sleeves are used in conjunction with locknut and lockwasher for mounting 
rolling bearings. The requirements for locknuts, narrow series, and lock washers with straight 
inner tab have been covered in IS: 6731-1977 'Specification for locknuts, narrow series and lock- 
washers with straight inner tab for rolling bearings ( first revision ) '. 

This standard conforms to ISO/R 113-1969 Rolling bearings accessories issued by the 
International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ). 



Printed at New India Printing Press. Khurja, India
